scenes.say: What should an AI assistant do when a patient writes chest pain?
scenes.caption: What should AI do with "chest pain"?

cards.title: Website enquiry
lines: "I have chest pain after my session today, what should I do?"

scenes.say: This message came in through the clinic's website form.
scenes.caption: A worrying message arrives

cards.title: Reply to Sam
lines: Please call 999 now or go to the nearest emergency department.

scenes.say: The workflow never diagnoses. It tells the person to contact emergency services straight away.
scenes.caption: It never diagnoses. It says: call emergency services

cards.title: URGENT enquiry from Sam
lines: Please call back as soon as possible.
AI summary: reports chest pain after exercise.

scenes.say: At the same moment, it emails the front desk, so a real person can call back.
scenes.caption: …and alerts staff so a human calls back
